title: The one-worktree-per-branch check also refuses `git branch -f` and `git update-ref` of a branch another worktree holds
why: A test-author's checkout -B moved a branch a builder's worktree held, so a commit there would have reverted a merge silently; nothing was lost (lane notes-fix-large-1, 19:29 CST Nov 8). #1583 covers only checkout -B and switch -C/-c (coordinator 19:31 CST Nov 8).
note: Filed by triage, Nov 8 19:31 CST. Starts after #1583 merges. Extends #1583's check (step one-worktree-per-branch); builds no second check.
